capabilities.name: portfolio_created_tokens

capabilities.live_sample_finding: creator snapshot returned inner_count=1247, open_count=0, open_ratio=0. The returned 101 rows contained 93 launches with create_timestamp before the audited token T0, 1 at T0, and 7 after T0. capabilities.next_decision: Use as isolated prospective acquisition for Deployer Prior Quality. Prefer signal-time snapshot features (created total, graduation/open count/rate, prior-best ATH excluding current token when identifiable) and separately reconstruct immutable launch cadence from raw-chain creation events. Do not backfill current ATH/open_ratio to old T0.

capabilities.name: token_holders_top100
capabilities.purpose: Structural Quality / Participant Structure / concentration and overlap audit
capabilities.command: gmgn-cli token holders --chain sol --address <token_address> --limit 100 --order-by amount_percentage --direction desc --raw
capabilities.event_at: per-wallet activity/holding timestamps exist, but there is no documented as_of timestamp for the holder-list snapshot itself
capabilities.observed_at: NOT PROVIDED by endpoint; local request_before/response_after required
capabilities.provenance: GMGN current top-holder snapshot plus GMGN wallet/token labels and funding metadata
capabilities.historical_availability: no documented historical holder snapshot or as_of/block/time cutoff
capabilities.rate_limit: to be measured/read from CLI/API behavior
capabilities.missingness: top 100 only; not a complete holder census unless coverage proves it; labels/funding metadata may be missing
capabilities.point_in_time_safety: RETROSPECTIVE / STRUCTURAL BENCHMARK by default. Can become a prospective causal snapshot only if queried and locally observed before the signal decision cutoff.
capabilities.lookahead_risk: HIGH when queried after the outcome; balances, PnL, sell progress and labels reflect later state
capabilities.survivorship_risk: MEDIUM; top-100 ranking is current-balance selected and may omit wallets that fully exited
capabilities.amount_percentage_semantics: fraction of TOTAL token supply (0-1). The separate GMGN holder-analysis skill may rebase to tradeable float, but raw API amount_percentage is total-supply share.
structural_derivations_candidate: repeated participant overlap across prospectively stored snapshots
concentration persistence/decay across prospectively stored snapshots
capabilities.our_equivalent_raw_data: partial; concentration/funding/entity structure is derivable from raw chain but not all is currently implemented
capabilities.potential_incremental_value: MEDIUM-HIGH if snapshots can be captured causally; otherwise benchmark/hypothesis mining only
capabilities.measured_expected_latency: 984 ms request duration in real Solana sample
capabilities.live_sample_finding: Only 4 rows were returned ~63m after T0. The Pump pool itself was addr_type=2/exchange=pump and held amount_percentage=1, while the three non-pool wallets had already exited. Raw top-N concentration would therefore be misleading without pool/curve exclusion and a prospective snapshot.
capabilities.next_decision: Remain AUDIT_ONLY; future structural experiment must exclude addr_type=2/pool rows and snapshot before decision cutoff.
